sentences.text: El domingo por la noche hubo un trueno muy grande, y un rayo cayó cerca de la casa.
sentences.english: On Sunday night there was a very loud thunderclap, and a bolt of lightning fell near the house.

sentences.text: Oí a un vecino gritar.
sentences.english: I heard a neighbor shout.

sentences.text: Hubo una inundación en la calle, y un niño lloró.
sentences.english: There was a flood in the street, and a boy cried.

sentences.text: Sin luz, la oscuridad era grande.
sentences.english: Without electricity, the darkness was great.

sentences.text: Más tarde llegó una noticia: había un incendio pequeño en otra calle.
sentences.english: Later the news came that there was a small fire on another street.

sentences.text: Todos escaparon, y no hubo peligro.
sentences.english: Everyone got out, and there was no danger.

sentences.text: No fue un huracán, y no fue un accidente grande, pero todos tuvimos un susto.
sentences.english: It was not a hurricane, and it was not a big accident, but we all got a fright.

sentences.text: Mi celular cayó al agua y se rompió.
sentences.english: My phone fell into the water and broke.

sentences.text: Yo estaba triste, porque no podía avisar a mi familia.
sentences.english: I was sad, because I could not let my family know.

sentences.text: El lunes por la mañana, le pregunté a doña Marta: —¿Me presta su celular?
sentences.english: On Monday morning, I asked doña Marta, "Will you lend me your phone?

sentences.text: Tengo que avisar a mi jefe.
sentences.english: I have to let my boss know."

sentences.text: Doña Marta me respondió: —Claro que sí.
sentences.english: Doña Marta answered me, "Of course.

sentences.text: Tomá.
sentences.english: Here."

sentences.text: Me prestó su celular y me explicó cómo usarlo.
sentences.english: She lent me her phone and explained how to use it.

sentences.text: Era un celular viejo, pero era bueno.
sentences.english: It was an old phone, but it was a good one.

sentences.text: Le prometí devolverlo por la tarde.
sentences.english: I promised her I would give it back in the afternoon.

sentences.text: Llamé a Daniel, el jefe del equipo.
sentences.english: I called Daniel, the head of the team.

sentences.text: Él contestó.
sentences.english: He answered.

sentences.text: —Daniel, soy Sam.
sentences.english: "Daniel, it's Sam.

sentences.text: Mi celular se rompió, y estoy con el celular de doña Marta.
sentences.english: My phone broke, and I am using doña Marta's phone."

sentences.text: —¿Estás bien? —me preguntó.
sentences.english: "Are you all right?" he asked me.

sentences.text: —Sí, estoy bien.
sentences.english: "Yes, I am fine."

sentences.text: ¿Cuándo es la reunión? —le pregunté.
sentences.english: "When is the meeting?" I asked him.

sentences.text: —Empieza a las ocho.
sentences.english: "It starts at eight.

sentences.text: Pero el lugar cambió.
sentences.english: But the place changed.

sentences.text: Va a ser en la iglesia, no en la casa de Luis.
sentences.english: It is going to be at the church, not at Luis's house."

sentences.text: —Gracias por avisarme —le dije.
sentences.english: "Thank you for letting me know," I told him.

sentences.text: Daniel me ofreció un celular viejo del equipo, en una caja.
sentences.english: Daniel offered me an old phone from the team, in a box.

sentences.text: Le agradecí mucho.
sentences.english: I thanked him very much.

sentences.text: —El sábado te doy el celular —dijo.
sentences.english: "I will give you the phone on Saturday," he said.

sentences.text: Carlos es mecánico.
sentences.english: Carlos is a mechanic.

sentences.text: Quiere conseguir un empleo en una empresa de la ciudad.
sentences.english: He wants to get a job at a company in the city.

sentences.text: La empresa paga un buen sueldo, pero necesita gente que hable otro idioma.
sentences.english: The company pays a good wage, but it needs people who speak another language.

sentences.text: Carlos me dijo: —Sam, ¿me enseñás tu idioma?
sentences.english: Carlos said to me, "Sam, will you teach me your language?

sentences.text: Hablá conmigo un poco cada día.
sentences.english: Talk with me a little each day."

sentences.text: Yo le respondí que sí.
sentences.english: I answered him yes.

sentences.text: Me explicó que no quiere gastar dinero en una escuela.
sentences.english: He explained to me that he does not want to spend money on a school.

sentences.text: Hicimos un horario: dos horas el sábado y dos horas el domingo.
sentences.english: We made a schedule: two hours on Saturday and two hours on Sunday.

sentences.text: Carlos me ofreció arreglar mi celular.
sentences.english: Carlos offered to fix my phone.

sentences.text: Abrió el celular, pero no pudo.
sentences.english: He opened it, but he could not.

sentences.text: —El agua acabó con él —dijo.
sentences.english: "The water finished it," he said.

sentences.text: Le agradecí la ayuda.
sentences.english: I thanked him for the help.

sentences.text: Le prometí enseñar mucho.
sentences.english: I promised him I would teach him a lot.

sentences.text: Con un buen empleo, Carlos va a ahorrar en el banco.
sentences.english: With a good job, Carlos is going to save at the bank.

sentences.text: Así puede ganar más y gastar menos.
sentences.english: That way he can earn more and spend less.

sentences.text: Su tío tiene una chamba en la empresa, y por eso Carlos tiene ganas de aprender.
sentences.english: His uncle has a job at the company, and that is why Carlos is eager to learn.

sentences.text: Por la tarde, Ana y Karla llegaron a la casa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, Ana and Karla came to doña Marta's house.

sentences.text: Ellas me ofrecieron café y pan.
sentences.english: They offered me coffee and bread.

sentences.text: A ellas les agradecí el café.
sentences.english: I thanked them for the coffee.

sentences.text: Ellas estaban contentas.
sentences.english: They were happy.

sentences.text: Karla me dijo: —Sin celular, es difícil.
sentences.english: Karla said to me, "Without a phone, it is hard.

sentences.text: Yo te presto mi celular esta noche.
sentences.english: I will lend you my phone tonight."

sentences.text: Ana dijo: —Vení conmigo al mercado.
sentences.english: Ana said, "Come with me to the market.

sentences.text: Te enseño a comprar plátanos.
sentences.english: I'll teach you how to buy bananas."

sentences.text: —Con gusto —le dije—.
sentences.english: "With pleasure," I told her.

sentences.text: Pero primero tengo que hablar con Luis.
sentences.english: "But first I have to talk to Luis."

sentences.text: Luis nos dijo a todos que la reunión empieza a las ocho.
sentences.english: Luis told all of us that the meeting starts at eight.

sentences.text: Daniel nos llamó también.
sentences.english: Daniel called us too.

sentences.text: Karla quiere saber cuándo vuelvo al mercado.
sentences.english: Karla wants to know when I am going back to the market.

sentences.text: Yo no sé cuándo, pero voy a ir con Ana.
sentences.english: I do not know when, but I am going with Ana.

sentences.text: Doña Marta nos invitó a cenar.
sentences.english: Doña Marta invited us to dinner.

sentences.text: Les prometí a todos que voy a estar en la reunión.
sentences.english: I promised everyone that I would be at the meeting.

sentences.text: La primera hora fue el sábado.
sentences.english: The first hour was on Saturday.

sentences.text: Carlos llegó con un libro y un café.
sentences.english: Carlos arrived with a book and a coffee.

sentences.text: Aprendimos las palabras de la empresa: jefe, horario, sueldo y empleo.
sentences.english: We learned the words of the company: boss, schedule, wage and job.

sentences.text: Carlos escribía cada palabra en su libro.
sentences.english: Carlos wrote each word in his book.

sentences.text: Yo decía la palabra, y él decía la palabra.
sentences.english: I said the word, and he said the word.

sentences.text: Antes de irse, dijo: —Mañana más.
sentences.english: Before leaving, he said, "More tomorrow."

sentences.text: Yo estaba cansado, pero contento.
sentences.english: I was tired, but happy.

sentences.text: Ese día, Daniel me dio el celular del equipo.
sentences.english: That day, Daniel gave me the team phone.

sentences.text: Era viejo, pero era bueno.
sentences.english: It was old, but it was good.

sentences.text: Esa noche escribí mi semana en el celular de Karla.
sentences.english: That night I wrote my week on Karla's phone.

sentences.text: Hoy: devolver el celular de doña Marta.
sentences.english: Today: return doña Marta's phone.

sentences.text: Mañana: llamar a Daniel y buscar el nuevo celular.
sentences.english: Tomorrow: call Daniel and look for the new phone.

sentences.text: Sábado: dos horas con Carlos.
sentences.english: Saturday: two hours with Carlos.

sentences.text: Domingo: dos horas con Carlos, y la iglesia.
sentences.english: Sunday: two hours with Carlos, and church.

sentences.text: Les dije a todos que voy a escribir un mensaje.
sentences.english: I told everyone that I was going to write a message.

sentences.text: Para doña Marta: «Doña Marta, aquí está su celular.
sentences.english: For doña Marta: "Doña Marta, here is your phone.

sentences.text: Muchas gracias por todo.»
sentences.english: Thank you very much for everything."

sentences.text: Para Luis: «Luis, gracias por explicarme todo.
sentences.english: For Luis: "Luis, thank you for explaining everything to me.

sentences.text: Un café para ti el sábado.»
sentences.english: A coffee for you on Saturday."

sentences.text: Luis contestó: «Con gusto, Sam.
sentences.english: Luis answered: "My pleasure, Sam.

sentences.text: Nos vemos.»
sentences.english: See you."

sentences.text: Para Carlos: «Carlos, ya tengo el horario.
sentences.english: For Carlos: "Carlos, I have the schedule now.

sentences.text: Gracias por tu ayuda.
sentences.english: Thank you for your help.

sentences.text: Esto es para ti: un pan.»
sentences.english: This is for you: a bread."

sentences.text: Para Ana: «Ana, gracias por el café.
sentences.english: For Ana: "Ana, thank you for the coffee.

sentences.text: Gracias a ti, ya conozco el mercado.»
sentences.english: Thanks to you, I already know the market."

sentences.text: Ana contestó: «De nada, Sam.
sentences.english: Ana answered: "You're welcome, Sam.

sentences.text: El sábado vamos de nuevo.»
sentences.english: On Saturday we are going again."

sentences.text: Por la tarde devolví el celular a doña Marta.
sentences.english: In the afternoon I returned the phone to doña Marta.

sentences.text: —Gracias, doña Marta —le dije.
sentences.english: "Thank you, doña Marta," I told her.

sentences.text: Ella agregó: —Si necesitás ayuda, hablá conmigo.
sentences.english: She added, "If you need help, talk with me."

sentences.text: Ella me respondió: —De nada, Sam.
sentences.english: She answered me, "You're welcome, Sam.

sentences.text: Un celular no es nada.
sentences.english: A phone is nothing.

sentences.text: Un favor es mucho.
sentences.english: A favor is a lot."

sentences.text: Parecía un buen día.
sentences.english: It seemed like a good day.

sentences.text: Y yo tenía muchos amigos.
sentences.english: And I had many friends.
